editorial:
Imagine being one of the last people on Earth, fixing drones and living in a sleek tower above the clouds. That is Jack Harper's life in Oblivion. He thinks he knows his mission and his world, but everything changes when he rescues a mysterious woman from a crashed ship. Her arrival cracks open his reality and sends him on a journey that questions who he really is and what happened to humanity. The movie looks stunning, with wide empty landscapes, cool floating tech, and a lonely vibe that pulls you in right away.

Tom Cruise brings his usual energy and makes Jack easy to root for. The action scenes are exciting, the mystery keeps you guessing, and the visuals are top notch. Some parts move a little slow, and the story borrows ideas from other sci-fi films, but it still feels fresh enough to enjoy. If you like big sci-fi adventures with heart, this one is for you. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: Jack learns he is actually a clone of the original Jack Harper, and the Tet is an alien machine stealing Earth's resources. The so-called Scavs are really human survivors. Jack flies a bomb into the Tet and sacrifices himself to destroy it, while another clone survives to live with Julia and their daughter. Humanity is finally free.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves sci-fi adventures with twists and stunning visuals.
